Without this permission, Regimen can\'t check for new heart rate and calorie data while it\'s closed.
Regimen can attach heart rate and calorie data from apps like Google Health or Samsung Health to your workouts.
Regimen needs permission to read heart rate and calorie data from Health Connect before it can attach anything to your workouts.
Couldn\'t request that permission. Grant it from your device\'s app settings instead.
This removes the heart rate and calorie data Regimen has already pulled from your workouts. If you turn Health Connect back on later, only data still within the check window comes back automatically.
